name_en: EWLA Dire Dawa office — free legal aid
name_am: የኢትዮጵያ የሴቶች ሕግ ባለሙያዎች ማኅበር (EWLA) ድሬ ዳዋ ቢሮ – ነፃ የሕግ ድጋፍ
location_description_en: Airport road, next to the federal customs and revenue office, Lawyers building, first floor.
location_description_am: ኤርፖርት መንገድ፣ ከፌዴራል ጉምሩክና ገቢዎች ቢሮ አጠገብ፣ የሕግ ባለሙያዎች ሕንፃ፣ አንደኛ ፎቅ።
source_text_original: Dire Dawa Airport road next to federal custom and revenue office Lawyers building first floor … Tel: 0254110540 … We provide free legal advice and representation to all women and girls, ensuring equitable access to justice across both development and crisis-affected environments.

additional_sources.name: EWLA — Annual Report 2023 (published June 2024)
additional_sources.note: "has opened its regional offices in seven regions and one city administration namely Adama, Hawassa, Bahir Dar, Gambella, Asosa, Jigjiiga, Semera regions and city administration of Dire Dawa."

notes_en: For women and girls. Hours are not stated. Number normalised to international format.
notes_am: ለሴቶችና ልጃገረዶች። የሥራ ሰዓት አልተገለጸም። ቁጥሩ ወደ ዓለም አቀፍ ቅርጽ ተቀይሯል።
